titlePlain: Containing a Compromised Account vs. a Compromised
subtitle: Lesson 15 · Containment Strategies

steps.label: Account
steps.sub: disable, reset password, revoke active sessions/tokens

steps.label: Host
steps.sub: isolate the machine — EDR cuts network access, keeps it running

code:
Disable account only
  -> malware on the host harvests a NEW credential

Isolate host only
  -> stolen login still works from anywhere else
caption: An attacker using a compromised account from a compromised host needs both shut at once.

steps.label: Odd Sign-In
steps.sub: unfamiliar location, unexpected MFA prompt — account problem

steps.label: Odd Process
steps.sub: C2 beacon, EDR flag on one machine — host problem

steps.label: Both at Once
steps.sub: login followed by activity from that same device — contain both

subtitle: What containing fast can cost you if you're not careful.
